rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Globalization brings both opportunity and cultural loss — mention both effects.
Diaspora themes: identity, nostalgia, belonging; use these three keywords.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Globalisation answers need BOTH faces: opportunity (trade, technology, jobs) and threat (cultural erosion, inequality) — one-sided answers sit in the middle band.  ·  Trick 2: Diaspora questions revolve around identity — 'neither fully here nor there'; use the words displacement, nostalgia, hybrid identity.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. What challenges do diaspora communities face? (2 marks) — identity conflict and discrimination; loss of language across generations.
